$comment: Law 29: architecture invariants are enforced by guards, not prose. pnpm verify runs them at gate time; these hooks run at authorship time, so a violation is reported against the edit that caused it rather than against a batch. Exit 2 is the blocking-error protocol: the output is fed back to the agent, which fixes it before continuing. PostToolUse runs the guards after a write -- read-only, ~1.4s over the whole workspace. PreToolUse refuses the write itself when it targets generated state or the phase authority, because for those there is nothing to fix afterwards: the file is derived, and regenerating it is the only correct answer. It restates no paths -- classify() in tooling/source-universe.mjs is the single authority -- and it fails OPEN, so it assists authorship without becoming a check the gate is not.
